title: Debezium-MySQL connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Debezium-MySQL CDC instance's settings: the source server and the properties loams-fabric renders into Debezium Server's application.properties. This is a source-only connector (design §33 §8 row 5; CN1 plan Task 8, §33 §7 D357). `password` and `tls.key_pem` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list; the rendered properties file reads them from files mounted at run time, never from this config (CN1 Ruling 6, Global Constraints).

connector_class.description: The Debezium connector class, matching the manifest's runtime.ref.

user.description: The account Debezium connects as; it needs REPLICATION SLAVE, REPLICATION CLIENT and SELECT.

password.description: The account's password. Resolved through the secret store (D189); the rendered properties file reads it from a mounted file.

topic_prefix.description: The Debezium topic prefix; topics become <prefix>.<schema>.<table> (§33 §7).

server_id.description: The replication server id Debezium registers as; unique among the replicas of one server.

binlog_name.description: The binlog file to start at. CN1 lets Debezium read it from its offset store instead.

snapshot_mode.description: The initial snapshot mode (CN1 Task 8: snapshot.mode=initial; incremental snapshots go through the signal table).

table_include_list.description: Tables to capture, as a regex; all tables when omitted.

ingest_url.description: The HTTP sink URL, http://<ingest>/v1/namespaces/{ns}/fabric/topics/{topic}/events (CN1 Ruling 6). Derived from the instance's Fabric binding when omitted.

schema_history_store.description: Debezium's schema history store (Q350: file on a PVC in CN1).

offset_store.description: Debezium's offset store (Q350: file on a PVC in CN1; Redis is a later option).

slot_lag_alert_bytes.description: The retained-binlog or retained-WAL threshold that raises an alert (§33 §7: default 10 GiB, an estimate).

tls.description: TLS material for the source connection.

enabled.description: Whether TLS is on at all.

key_pem.description: The client certificate's private key. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

verify_full.description: Whether the server certificate's hostname is verified.
